figurative_meaning_en: To fall into a trap due to greed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে লোভে ইঁদুর কলে পড়ে গেল এবং সবকিছু হারাল।
ব্যবসায়ে লোভ না করে সতর্ক থাকো, না হলে ইঁদুর কলে পড়বে।
example_sentences_in_english: He fell into the trap like a rat due to his greed and lost everything.
In business, don't be greedy or you'll end up caught like a rat in a trap.
note: This idiom draws from common rural imagery of rat traps, emphasizing moral lessons on avarice in Bengali oral traditions.
